title: 第十章 、计划失利？意外的坠落，满天的积木碎片
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一眨眼间，老吴就带着老赵来到端木棠梨所说的金色放大镜积木上面。

“赵叔，我的任务已经完成，剩下的事情就交给你。”

“我尽量。”

老赵心里很紧张，现在小队里面，就只有他手里的拐杖能对积木造成击倒效果，还不至于伤到积木，触犯某种死亡规则，意识着他这次行动不成功便成仁。

“吃老爷子一仗。”

老赵第一次攻击没有成功触发百分百击倒效果，蓝色水滴七号图案积木没有任何动弹，老爷子击打积木的力道就像是重拳落到棉花上，一点效果都没有。

“再来一次，这次一定能行。”

老赵不甘心继续使用拐杖，第二次使用也以失败告终。

“算了，我们想想看其他办法。”

端木棠梨见赵老爷子已经失败两次，当机立断否定这次计划，转而思考其他法子。

“你到底行不行，行不通，就换三哥上，三哥肯定比你更厉害。”

老六看着倒计时不断减少，他急得上火，脑子不过弯就要自家三哥顶上去。

老赵不死心继续挥舞拐杖，坚决认为自己这一次一定能行，接着继续失败。

老吴无聊站在一边等着事情出结果，他好第一时间将人接走。

下面的争论跟二人无法扯上关系，如今场上能有决断权就是梦煜三姐弟、端木棠梨三主仆、数字三人组，现在数字三人组想要谋权篡位，罢免端木棠梨的指挥权，那就要看梦煜三姐弟意思。

“梦煜，你们觉得如何？”

因此端木棠梨将决断权交给梦煜三姐弟，询问他们的意见。

“我们意见维持现有情况不变。”

梦煜想都不想直接选择端木棠梨当队长，引得老六暴怒练练，“你这蠢货，没看见她指挥都失利，一个积木都没抽出去，你还选择她当队长，是想着跟她这个蠢货一起送死吗？”

“如果之前你们能把自己手里的道具开诚布公说出来，我会考虑支持你们的人上位，现在嘛，还是人家大小姐诚意更足，支持你们上位，我担心自己会被当成炮灰袒露的。”

不愧是做律师的，梦煜发言极为犀利，老六被他说的哑口无言，不敢再提抢指挥权的事情。

“那么大小姐，我们等会要如何行事？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the blink of an eye, Old Wu took Old Zhao to the golden magnifying glass block Duanmu Tangli mentioned.

"Uncle Zhao, my mission has been completed, and I will leave the rest to you."

"I'll try my best."

Lao Zhao was very nervous. Now in the team, only the crutch in his hand could knock down the blocks without hurting the blocks and violating some kind of death rule. He realized that if his action failed this time, he would be a benevolent person.

"Have a fight with the old man."

Lao Zhao's first attack failed to trigger the 100% knockdown effect. The blue water drop No. 7 pattern block did not move at all. The force of the old man hitting the block was like a heavy punch falling on cotton, with no effect at all.

"Do it again, it will work this time."

Lao Zhao was unwilling to continue using crutches, and the second use ended in failure.

"Forget it, let's think of other ways."

Duanmu Tangli saw that Mr. Zhao had failed twice, so he immediately rejected the plan and turned to think of other methods.

"Whether you can do it or not? If it doesn't work, let's switch to the third brother. The third brother will definitely be more powerful than you."

Lao Liu watched the countdown continue to decrease. He was so anxious that he asked his third brother to go ahead if he couldn't think of anything wrong.

Lao Zhao refused to give up and continued to wave his cane, firmly believing that he would be able to do it this time, and then continued to fail.

Lao Wu was bored and stood aside waiting for the outcome of the matter so that he could pick him up as soon as possible.

The following argument has nothing to do with the two of them. Now the three mengyu siblings, Duanmu Tangli and the three masters and servants, and the digital trio have the decision-making power on the court. Now that the digital trio wants to usurp the throne and remove Duanmu Tangli from command, it depends on the wishes of the three mengyu siblings.

"Meng Yu, what do you think?"

Therefore, Duanmu Tangli handed over the decision-making power to the three Mengyu siblings and asked for their opinions.

"We are of the opinion that the current situation remains unchanged."

Meng Yu didn't even think about choosing Duanmu Tangli as the captain, which made Lao Liu furious and said, "You idiot, you didn't see that she failed in commanding and didn't even take out a single block. You still chose her as the captain. Do you want to die with this idiot like her?"

"If you had been able to tell the truth about the props in your hands before, I would have considered supporting your person to take the position. Now, the eldest lady is more sincere and supports you to take the position. I am worried that I will be exposed as cannon fodder."

As expected of a lawyer, Meng Yu spoke very sharply. Lao Liu was speechless by what he said and did not dare to mention the matter of grabbing command power again.

"So, Miss, what are we going to do later?"
